paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between testing parameter k and correlation values for two datasets labeled "Consistency-CE" and "Consistency-Bi." The x-axis represents "testing k ", utilizes a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 10, and features regularly spaced tick marks at intervals of 2 units without specified units. The y-axis represents "Correlation" on a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The "Consistency-CE" line is depicted with a blue color, circle markers, and a dashed line style, starting at slightly above 0.6 at k = 1 , rising to about 0.75 at k = 9 , with a noticeable upward trend. The "Consistency-Bi" line appears in orange with square markers and a solid line style, beginning around 0.95 at k = 1 and maintaining a nearly constant value close to 0.99 through to k = 9 . A legend is available at the bottom left of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
